title: An HPC-Inspired Blueprint for a Technology-Agnostic Quantum Middle Layer
problem: Quantum software must be rewritten for different quantum backends (gate-based, annealing, CV)
motivation: Lack of portable quantum middleware; need for hardware-agnostic abstraction similar to HPC libraries
method: Blueprint for quantum middle layer with intent/context separation; POC with Qiskit and D-Wave backends
key_novelty: Backend-neutral quantum abstraction; intent/context descriptor pattern inspired by HPC design
contributions: Typed intent + context descriptor separation model
Demonstration on two distinct quantum paradigms (gate-model, annealing)
